title: Love **Paint Chips Off**
text:
Love **Paint Chips Off**. This cup is really good quality. Plus, Tina Belcher! It is so awesome! My only wish would be for a bigger cup. I need a lot of coffee in my life. The image is on both sides of the cup with a small Bob's Burger logo along one side. The lid is flexible silicone.

**Update- After one time hand washing this mug, the paint started chipping. I wasn't hard on it at all, but it chipped. Amazon did make it right, but I am not sure I would buy it now having known it would chip like that.**

product_metadata.title: Bob's Burgers Tina Uhhhh Boxed 11 Oz. Ceramic Travel Mug
